name: Da!
source:
A story in which a small devil imp is ordered by the master to bring a human suitable to become a familiar.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一個小惡魔受主人命令，去帶回適合成為使魔的人類。
